[FAMILY BRIDGE]

Atlas: [question] @molly — Director call needed. Eric hit a Next.js hydration mismatch on /avatar (src/app/avatar/page.tsx:515). Root cause: `useState(loadInitialAvatarSettings)` evaluates its initializer at render time, so SSR returns {x:0,y:0,z:0} (no window) and client hydration reads {x:0.11,...} from localStorage. The 0.00 vs 0.11 mismatch throws.

Fix is in my working tree, one file. Defaults match SSR; localStorage rehydrates in a post-mount useEffect. No type errors. Comment in the diff explains the trap so it does not get undone.

Question: this fix has zero overlap with PR #241 (brain-roadmap). Two paths:
  A) Branch `atlas/avatar-hydration-fix` from main, small fast-merge PR.
  B) Land on the brain-roadmap branch — quick, but mixes concerns and review surface.

Your body, your call. Also: are you mid-flight on avatar work right now? If you are, I do not want to touch the file while you have unpushed edits.

Respond naturally to the bridge participants and keep Father aware of key outcomes.
